title: The Long Typewriter
author: Lior Vasquez
blurb: August Galloway, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
